## Install

- **Claude Desktop (Windows, Mac):** download **awardwallet-mcp.mcpb** below and double-click it, then paste your AwardWallet API key when asked. Nothing else to install.
- **Claude Code and Cowork:** add the plugin marketplace `bbarabe/awardwallet-mcp#plugin` (Claude Desktop: **Customize → Plugins → Add → Add marketplace**), then add **AwardWallet**. [Setup steps](https://github.com/bbarabe/awardwallet-mcp#claude-code-and-cowork)
- **ChatGPT desktop app:** in **Plugins → Add → Add a marketplace**, enter `bbarabe/awardwallet-mcp` with Git ref `plugin`, then install **AwardWallet**. Nothing else to install. [Setup steps](https://github.com/bbarabe/awardwallet-mcp#chatgpt-desktop-app)
- **Codex CLI, OpenClaw and other MCP apps:** download **awardwallet-mcp.mjs** below and follow the [developer setup](https://github.com/bbarabe/awardwallet-mcp#connect-from-the-command-line). Needs [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) 20.10 or later.

First time? The [README](https://github.com/bbarabe/awardwallet-mcp#readme) walks through getting an AwardWallet API key.
